bio.text: Juan Ciscomani represents Arizona's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2022.
He attended public schools in Tucson, Pima Community College and the University of Arizona, and worked for the university and the Tucson Hispanic Chamber of Commerce.
He later served in Arizona Governor Doug Ducey's administration as Senior Advisor and Vice-Chair of the Arizona-Mexico Commission.
According to his office, he lives in Tucson with his wife, Laura, and their six children.
